disorder-name.detail: Autism spectrum disorder; ASD males used as clinical cohort for normative modelling. Females (N=116 in matched sample) were excluded from NM analysis due to insufficient data-points per age bin.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "A normative modelling approach reveals age-atypical cortical thickness in a subgroup of males with autism spectrum disorder"

dataset-of-origin.detail: ABIDE I and ABIDE II combined. Both datasets used together for the ASD clinical cohort.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "we utilized the ABIDE datasets (ABIDE I and II; 15)"

age.detail: Age statistics from Table 1 (Sample age characteristics after normative modelling selection), ASD group (males only, N=699). Age bins with fewer than 5 TD data-points were excluded; subjects without resting-state fMRI were also excluded.
age.location: Bethlehem2020.pdf.md: Results / Table 1 Sample age characteristics after normative modelling selection, L57-L61

sex.detail: Normative modelling was conducted on male ASD participants only (N=699 after normative modelling selection). Females (N=116 in the full matched sample of N=870, Table 2) were explicitly excluded from NM analysis because age-wise binning greatly reduced bins with sufficient data-points in the female group. The final clinical cohort used for NM application is therefore 100% male.
sex.supporting_text: "the age-wise binning greatly reduced the number of bins with enough data-points in the female group... we conducted normative modelling on the male group only"
sex.location: Bethlehem2020.pdf.md: Methods / Statistics and reproducibility, L155
